text: Only 2 blocks from me and very convenient. Can this be corrected or must something be said in my area? This is the only store to do this. Plus, I also purchased a pack, and when I got home, the pack said 'not for sale' on the rim of the pack. They also take out coupons on free pack purchases, which means you reimburse them more money. I have purchased another brand just not to give them the extra money, but I've been smoking local for so long I don't prefer anything else. I hope you can respond to me. Sandy Gektinger
